Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DellCry wrote:
>
> It's my understanding that cards cannot be played during bloodhunt votes.
> Can the player with the edge burn it to gain a vote? Is there anything else
> that can affect the outcome?

While action modifiers and reaction cards cannot be played during a bloodhunt
referendum (since there is no action to modify or react to), other effects
can be used (subject to card text) - each Methuselah can burn one Political
Action card to gain a vote, the Edge can be burned for a vote, ready titled
vampires provide their votes, Ventrue Headquarters can be tapped for three
votes, etc. Note that cards that say "during a political action" cannot be
used, since the bloodhunt is not a political action.

--

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <7dfbf0$32u$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>, carl.pi...@at.ccmail.p
hilips.com writes

>Anyway, I know that the Jyhad version had no "during...", but I thought
>that the VTES card had. My mistake. All other permanent cards that
>give votes state the "during..." clause. IMO Ventrue HQ should fall in line.

I disagree.

It's an unnecessary change, since it's difficult for the Ventrue to
abuse it. They rarely diablerise other vampires themselves, since they
aren't so hot in combat, so it's difficult for them to pro-actively
abuse the card. They can use it as a clever bartering tool during
votes, too.

Other clans with such cards *tend* to be fairly good in combat eg the
Mausoleum, Potence Dominate Giovanni - Oxford University, Brujah and so
forth.

The change isn't really warranted, and change for change's sake is not
good.

--
